stress_scope: Exploratory stress scenarios remain development-unqualified even when individual fresh references pass per-case checks; no case-level pass promotes them into the fixed primary cohort.
contact_representation: Exact piecewise-linear normal-force integration over clipped rest-surface triangles for planes and boxes, refined friction quadrature, and conservative sparse material-surface quadrature for spheres; shared configuration between reference and all physical predictors. Exact normal integration does not imply exact friction, continuous collision detection or converged trajectories.
inertia_representation: Consistent tetrahedral P1 mass for reference, FEM, native spring adaptation and matched vertex comparator; rigid comparator uses exact uniform-volume inertia. Contact damping law remains formulation-specific.

reasons: Spatial body center difference exceeds limit
Spatial body center difference exceeds limit

reference_accounting.interpretation: Primary target is fixed prospectively. Half-dt checks temporal consistency; companion mesh at the same base dt checks spatial consistency. Missing or failed checks remain unqualified; no target substitution.

reference_qualification: Per-case temporal/body checks plus distinct-mesh spatial companions at 27 exact shared points and 2678 P1-interpolated surface points; world RMS<=1mm, aligned shape RMS<=0.5mm, per-collider center RMS<=1mm. Both spatial resolutions require prior development timestep qualification. These checks are discretization consistency, not measured physical ground truth.
public_benchmark_scope: This controlled synthetic extension does not establish improvement on both archived public benchmarking datasets. The separate development-only rigid-pose transfer pilot is not promoted: SoftVT mean gain 0.0214mm with10 wins/10 losses; PhysTwin is unchanged.
study_relationship: Post-audit extension; historical vertex-contact experiment is preserved. Matched scene/mesh vertex-contact formulation comparison uses the new public geometry/stiffness and separately refitted calibration. Its contact damping mass differs, so it is not a pure quadrature ablation.
